message.content:
將兩個十六進制顏色 **#FAEBD7**（Antique White）和 **#00FFFF**（Cyan）平均混合（即對每個 RGB 分量取平均值）得到：

| 分量 | #FAEBD7 | #00FFFF | 平均 |
|------|---------|---------|------|
| R    | 250 (FA) |   0 (00) | 125 (7D) |
| G    | 235 (EB) | 255 (FF) | 245 (F5) |
| B    | 215 (D7) | 255 (FF) | 235 (EB) |

合併後的十六進制顏色為 **#7DF5EB**。

這是一種淡青色（類似於「Pale Turquoise」或「Light Cyan」的色調）。如果你想要更精確的顏色名稱，可以使用顏色工具或查詢色彩庫。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "混合顏色#FAEBD7和#00FFFF，新的顏色是什麼？" They want to mix two colors: #FAEBD7 (AntiqueWhite) and #00FFFF (Cyan). They want the resulting color. We need to compute the average of the RGB values. #FAEBD7: hex FA=250, EB=235, D7=215. #00FFFF: 0, 255, 255. Average: (250+0)/2=125, (235+255)/2=245, (215+255)/2=235. So new color: #7D F5 EB? Wait 125 decimal is 0x7D, 245 decimal is 0xF5, 235 decimal is 0xEB. So #7DF5EB. That is the average. But maybe they want mixing by blending? Usually mixing colors in digital space is averaging.
